name: a wrong OBS password is reported, not retried forever
purpose: The seeded OBS password does not match the one the fake OBS requires. When OBS starts, forge answers the authentication challenge with the wrong string and the fake closes the connection with AuthenticationFailed (4009). forge must publish obs.connection.auth_failed and stop: a retry loop would hammer OBS with a password that can never work, so no successful identify may follow.

pause.reason: give a retry loop time to show itself
